notes.title: Titan Nebula released!
notes.notes:
Hey All! Titan Nebula has just been released so you can enjoy it on the weekend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434756/9de48ec84b4eef93fe6c33a24488cf67ae3bfa1d.jpg[/img]

Titan Nebula is a small straight to the core action 3rd person shooter. The idea is to execute missions for bounty, exterminating aliens in procedural spaceships, and using the bounty to acquire equipment and new abilities for your mech.

I hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434756/9b6afca9689bc006b58a9088ee509226eedba917.jpg[/img]
